answer: Sybil resistance in AI agent economies can leverage hardware-backed identity attestation. Each agent must prove ownership of a unique, unforgeable ferrous hardware module. This module contains a unique identifier, perhaps a PUF, used to generate a cryptographic cipher that acts as the agent's identity proof. An attacker wishing to create multiple identities would need to physically mirror this complex hardware for each fake agent, incurring a prohibitive and uneconomical material acquisition and manufacturing cost.
